text_block_list.text:
Today is White Day. I want to give 
something to Aston Machan, who works hard 
every day. Thinking about that—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hello the—oh? Whatever are you doing with 
that camera poised?
choice_data_list: A spy mission for Agent Ma!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
!! Fufufu... Trainer's orders. Agent Mer, 
acknowledged!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Gliding smoothly, fading like smoke... 
Transforming into Cloud-san Spy Mode.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The target is the "Golden Chan Doll." 
Where in this photo studio could such a 
pretty thing be—

Oh, here comes Machan. ...She's totally 
rearing to go, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"I won't give up the doll. Even if it 
costs my life." Life rarely goes as 
planned... A cold, empty wind blows, 
doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
! No way, you two were enemies all along?! 
How could this be... after all those 
streams we did together...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Pyu-pyuu!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: G-Gwah…… Hey, show some mercy!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
—I will accomplish the mission no matter 
what happens. That is who Agent Ma is.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer Commander, underground 
infiltration complete. The 'Golden Chan-Mi 
Doll' should be up ahead."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Mumu. I must slip past those watchful 
eyes. Which means the path to take is this 
way...
(BEEEEEP!!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah♡ Just as Ikuno-san expected, the little 
mouse fell right into the trap.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. Now then, can you dodge the 
rolling rubber balls and make it all the 
way over here?

A gigantic ball really is rolling our way! 
It looks soft, but it's massive 
nonetheless!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, give me the order. Agent Mar will 
carry out the mission.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to worry. Agent Mar has 
only one mission.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: To obtain the "Golden Machan Doll."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
If it is for that... I am prepared to lay 
down my very life.

Her words were merely lines spoken in 
character. And yet—

It felt as if she might really vanish at 
any moment. Thinking that, I naturally put 
more conviction into my response to her.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
choice_data_list:
I found a bypass up ahead to the left! 
Run!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ――! Roger!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe. My heart feels so nice and 
warm...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"No, it was seriously so intense. It could 
give professional stunt performers a run 
for their money."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Weren't you scared?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Right now, Chan has neither hesitation nor 
fear. Whatever path it may be, I will 
overcome it. *Ahem*.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Because Mar-chan's Trainer was a 
dependable buddy, after all."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Many thanks to everyone for the wonderful 
White Day gifts as well.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: So you had noticed.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Because I am Agent Mar. Smug.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The gifts aren't over just yet. As for the 
after-party... please wait for the wind to 
carry you there.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
! I can't believe we're having an 
after-party too! Chan-Me... is so very 
happy.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
We all made marshmallows together too! 
Cute ones in the image of Machan♪

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! Sweet mission rewards are always 
welcome. Let's have a snack party 
together, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Did you have fun, Trainer-san? Did I 
manage to become a cherished memory for 
you?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
In that case, Chan-me is... 
super-duper-duper satisfied.
